notes.title: Patch Notes – Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood – Demo Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
General Fixes & Improvements:

 Melee Animations: Fixed an issue where melee enemies would run toward the player with their hands still down.
 Physics Assets: Added physics materials to map assets for more realistic footsteps and bullet impact effects.
 Footsteps Sounds: Introduced new footstep sound effects for mud, metal, wood, gravel, and dirt surfaces.


Gameplay Adjustments:

 Melee Attacks: Adjusted to have a wider area of effect for better combat consistency.
 Loot Boxes: Reworked the opening sequence and added a new open sound effect for better feedback.
 Rolling: Added a dedicated rolling sound effect for improved immersion.


UI & Weapon System Updates:
Weapon Menu:

 Now features a comparison system that highlights differences in damage, fire rate, deflection, and magazine size when hovering over weapons compared to the currently equipped one.
 Added a magazine size indicator in weapon details.
 Expanded weapon information for better clarity.


Audio & Visual Enhancements:

 Consoles: Updated with a new mesh, information indicator, and use sound effect for better interaction.
 Enemy Death Sequence: Changed from dissolving effect to a fast scale-down effect for improved visual impact.
 Sound Settings: Reduced ambient and music volume by 50% for better balance.


We’re constantly working to improve Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood and would love to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord community to share feedback, report bugs, and connect with fellow soldiers:

🔗 Join our Discord

Your input helps shape the battlefield—see you on the front lines!

notes.title: Patch Notes – Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood – Demo Update v0.1.1
notes.notes:
The latest update for Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood is live! This update includes several new adjustments and bug fixes, improving the overall gameplay experience. Here's a breakdown of what’s new:

Changes & Improvements:
- Melee Enemies now have idle animations when not in use, adding more immersion to their gameplay.
- Unwanted Laser Removed: Fixed an issue where a laser effect would appear with melee weapons unintentionally. This visual glitch has now been removed.
- Camera Shake Bug Fix: The bug causing unwanted camera shake when melee weapons were out of reach has been resolved.
- Swing Sound Adjustments: The sound effect of melee swings now has a range limit, ensuring it can only be heard from a reasonable distance, reducing audio clutter.

Backpack Notification Reworked:
- The Backpack Notify system has been reworked. Now, it triggers when a weapon is picked up, providing more accurate and timely feedback.

Version Counter Added:
- A version counter has been added in the game’s settings, allowing players to easily track the current game version.

Heal Warning Adjusted:
- The heal warning message has been adjusted and repositioned on the screen to improve visibility and reduce interference with other HUD elements.

AI Adjustments:
- Sight Range Reduced: The sight range for AI soldiers has been reduced from 2000 units to 1700 units, giving players more opportunities for stealth and ambush tactics.
- Attack Delay Reduced: The delay between AI soldiers detecting a target and launching an attack has been reduced from 2 seconds to 1 second, making AI combat behavior more responsive.
- AI Behavior Improvements: AI soldiers now react more naturally and are less likely to get stuck in terrain during combat.

Bug Fixes & Quality of Life:
- Fixed Melee Weapon Issues: Several bugs affecting melee combat have been addressed to improve weapon behavior, including collision detection and swing responsiveness.

Known Issues:
No significant new issues were introduced with this update, but as always, please report any new bugs or concerns to help us improve the game!
As always, we appreciate your feedback and support. We hope this update enhances your experience on the frontlines. See you in the trenches!

– The Frontline Fury Development Team
